## Description {#details}

<p>This helper class is used to match constant scalars, vector splats, and fixed width vectors that satisfy a specified predicate.</p>


<p>For fixed width vector constants, poison elements are ignored if AllowPoison is true.</p>


<p>Definition at line 356 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/patternmatch-h">PatternMatch.h</a>.</p>
